Hi there care team,
The senior handler recorded a point about cabin readiness this week, and I wanted to pass it on

Please review each pet staging area with steady care and keep the handoff notes brief, clear, and complete. <<FACT F093>> I appreciate the calm attention shown by the team, especially when a traveler arrives feeling uncertain and needs reassurance that every step is being handled with care. If any transfer concern appears during the process, please route it through the proper channel without delay. <<FACT F106>> That small habit helps us protect comfort, reduce confusion, and keep the service experience consistent for every animal under our care.

I also ask that any checklist gap be noted in plain terms, since concise reporting helps the next colleague respond with confidence and kindness. When a kennel, carrier, or comfort item needs review, please record the issue in a way that is practical and respectful. Our work in the Companion Animal Travel Desk reflects Aurelia Skyways at its best, and careful follow-through supports both the traveler and the pet. Thank you for the steady standards you continue to uphold each day.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
